purpose: Cross-country comparison of kidney function in a European research consortium funded by Horizon Europe.
question: How many adults have an eGFR below 60 on their latest measurement, by region?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Use the latest eGFR (LOINC 62238-1) per patient; patients without an eGFR are left out.
Reduced kidney function = latest eGFR below 60.
Report per region: adults with an eGFR and adults with reduced kidney function.
